Ordinary Light Armor

You pull the light armor close and fasten its straps; the fitted layers guard your body without swallowing your outline.

Rules

- ID: item-ordinary-light-armor - Bulk: 1 - Requirements / supply: Requires @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.1f6b36c34db9c5eb.JournalEntryPage.36ac9af60144cf5c]{Wear Light Armor} to benefit - Acquisition: Explicit ability grant, coins, or DA treasure; no automatic extra starting kit.

Appearance is chosen by owner. The training card grants physical resistance 1; no additional resistance from this item.

No DP price. Purchase does not grant training or an ability.

Equipment index

Market price: 10 coins; see @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.a8b099af3500d9f6.JournalEntryPage.cfa94361944ba875]{market rules}.
